scope: exploratory regular-season PTS/REB/AST counts, full game including overtime
history_policy: previous season plus current season before actual seal UTC date, latest 20 positive appearances; no target or same-date outcomes
candidate: fullgame_gamma_poisson; previous-season opening extension; exploratory for all markets
minutes: empirical past positive fullgame exposures; overtime retained; no forecast of current injury or rotation change
paper_contract: hypothetical one unit; positive minutes is participation; DNP void; overtime included; integer push refunds; no account settlement claim
selection: one preferred-book quote per event/player/market, lowest available line; highest EV side; stale preferred quote abstains without switching books
availability: unknown final availability; predictions and hypothetical entries conditional on participation, no actionable bets
injury_context: optional received ESPN injury feed; exact-name matches are candidates, not verified NBA crosswalks; any listed candidate abstains from hypothetical entry; no absence-as-health inference or numerical injury adjustment
reading: descriptive pilot at 50 completed event/player/market observations or 30 days from first seal; no promotion, repeated interim descriptive reports allowed
primary_metrics: over Brier on one fixed reference quote
uncertainty: descriptive only; dependent player/market observations are not independent confirmations; confirmatory power and cluster criteria pending D07
clv: missing unless a later fresh pregame quote for the same bookmaker/event/player/market/line is received; this pilot does not estimate CLV
